core_features: Martial heroes and/or cultivators striving for power, honor, or transcendence
Clans, sects, or schools with distinct martial or spiritual styles
Jianghu: a world of roaming heroes, vendettas, and shifting alliances
typical_settings: Ancient or pseudo-historical East Asian landscapes
Sect compounds, sacred mountains, martial arts arenas
typical_conflicts: The cost of pursuing ultimate power or transcendence
tone_guidelines: Heroic and melodramatic, with a mix of honor, tragedy, and soaring action.

required_elements: At least one martial art or cultivation technique that is clearly named or described
Clear hierarchy or structure among sects, clans, or schools
A conflict between personal feelings (love, loyalty) and martial/cultivation obligations
forbidden_elements: Purely modern, non-martial setting with no sense of cultivation or martial ethos
